content: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
source: Abu Dawud 2/179, Ahmad 3/411, al-Baghawi Sharh al-Sunnah 7/128 (graded hasan by al-Albani, Sahih Abi Dawud 1/354); the verse is Qur'an 2:201. Recited by the Prophet (peace be upon him) between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone on every circuit of Tawaf.

content: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
source: Sahih Muslim 2/888. Recited by the Prophet (peace be upon him) while standing atop Safa and Marwah, facing the Qibla, said three times, preceded by reciting Qur'an 2:158 ("Indeed, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah").
